'''grendelX SYCFA Flip & QMC (DS)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[grendelX]]
* '''Published:''' 23 January 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 SYCFA grendelX DS 2005 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Imperial Decree (V), Admiral Motti (V), Captain Lennox (V), Commander Praji (V), The Emperor (V), Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V), Imperial Domination (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Came in 14th out of 15th today for score of 4(-61) at Alderaan Worlds Qualifier My first Star Wars tournament...

== Notes ==

* GPN post 5919 holds two decks; this page is the Dark deck, and the Light deck is on the (LS) page.
* Original-era (V) cards: Admiral Motti (V), Commander Praji (V), Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V) (VS2); Reactor Terminal (V) (VS3); Captain Lennox (V), Imperial Domination (V) (VS4); Imperial Decree (V), The Emperor (V), Firepower (V) (VS6). Stalker is unmarked (printed).

== Strategy ==

DS 1-2/LS 1-2 22 January 2005
